newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian coconut oil stable, trading sluggish.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian coconut oil stable, trading sluggish.

text.p: Indonesian coconut oil and copra prices were generally stable in sluggish trading on Friday, traders said.
"The market continues to be weak with buyers only purchasing for immediate needs. There are no factors which could boost market sentiment at all," said one trader.
Traders said coconut oil was quoted at 1,750 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, while copra improved a bit to 800 rupiah/kg. Overall market sentiment remained weak due to poor demand, they said.
Some said many buyers had switched to palm olein because it was cheaper.
"It's hard to know exactly why demand is very poor. But I think it is safe to say that it is because olein is much more attractive for the consumers in term of price," said another trader.
Traders said demand for palm olein had strenghtened ahead of the weekend. Palm olein was quoted at 1,460-70 rupiah/kg in Jakarta on Friday.
Traders in Manila said on Monday coconut oil prices were expected to slide further this week due to prospects of better copra harvests from both the Philippines and Indonesia.
